items.scene: Nina lives with her mother and grandmother. Her mother works on Saturdays. Nina and her grandmother make lunch together on that day. They leave a plate for her mother, who comes home later.
items.prompt: Why do they leave a plate of food?
items.answer: Their mother will eat when she gets home.
options: Their mother will eat when she gets home.
Their grandmother does not like lunch.
items.why: The mother is at work and returns later. Saving her food connects the family action with her absence.
items.hint: Separate what the text says from what you can only guess.
